design.additive: Inspect crops only if the existing whole-image pass supplied no region.
design.delivery: Standard JPEG75 4:2:0 upright RGB, long side 768 and short side at least 512.
design.first_view: At most four source-corner 512-pixel squares without resampling.
design.geometry: Keep the original crop component on its native source coordinates.
design.quality: Apply the full-upload Q75 reliability mask and the original model response points to every crop.
design.ranking: Choose the strongest mutually supported candidate by original component mean, then by mutual overlap and exact area.
design.repeat_view: Shift each crop origin up to 32 pixels toward the source center along each available axis.
